Borders

Name every place that borders the one shown by land. For cities and regions, name the country they are in. Three wrong guesses and the round ends. Correct answers earn coins.

Neighbors found · coins earned from Borders 0 · 0

Each neighbor you find grants 5 coins. Finishing a country gives +15, and +15 more with no strikes. Bonus entries (like a city's region) earn coins but are not required. Only places from packs you have unlocked are picked, but their neighbors can be anywhere. Short rounds with fewer than 3 borders pay smaller completion bonuses.

Credits

Flag images are from Wikimedia Commons and Wikipedia, and each flag remains under its own license and with its original creators. Many are in the public domain; others are free-licensed (such as CC BY-SA), and image pages on Commons list the author and license for each file.

Map outlines are based on Natural Earth data (public domain), with some shapes adjusted for this game.

Facts and data come from public sources such as Wikipedia and Wikidata. FlagRNG is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with any country, organization or brand shown.

Progress is stored in this browser using localStorage.
This prototype does not have cloud saving or cross-device synchronization.

What's New?

FlagRNG has been completely revamped! It's no longer a slot machine. It's now a card RNG game: open packs, collect flags, and build your collection.

Hope you have fun and get to opening packs! 🎉
